name: Overrun / Push
text: Swap places with the enemy you Attack (walk over them and go behind): you take their hex and they take yours. Negate the enemy's Move. Alt: the enemy or ally is moved one tile away; step over them.

negate_kind.note: pass 2 (after Grapple, Disruption Move): an adjacent target (declared, else auto) cannot move — noMove.add; negated when it moved (M/EM); a character-targeted Attack on an adjacent enemy queues a swap {by, on} in ctx.swaps (2026-11-16). In-place register edits: JS this milestone.
